Subject: Intro: Skylark <> Redwood co-sell / integration

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the intro last week — excited to explore a tighter commercial relationship between Skylark Analytics and Redwood. We build a data enrichment layer used by several ISVs that could embed Redwood for in-app LLM features. There are three things we'd like to align on so we can commit engineering and go-to-market resources:

1) High-level commercial: target commission/rev-share for inbound leads we pass, and referral vs. reseller distinctions.
2) Lead registration and overlap policy: how do we protect leads we introduce so our reps get credit?
3) Joint MOP (mutual action plan) & onboarding timeline to get a pilot live.

I've attached a short integration spec and a draft MOP to give context (Skylark_Integration_Spec_v1.pdf; Skylark_MOP_v1.pdf).

Can you loop in the right folks on your side? Happy to do a 30-minute sync next week.

Best,

Hi Ella — thanks for the clear summary and for the docs.

High level: we’re very interested. Quick answers up front so Skylark can plan resources:

- Commission ranges: for simple referrals (intro only), standard referral credit is 8–12% of first-year ARR; for co-sell handed to Redwood sales we typically offer a 12–20% commission depending on involvement and deal size.
- Reseller arrangements (Skylark resells Redwood as part of a bundled solution) are treated as partner-managed deals with margin/discounts instead of straight commission — we can share a reseller price list once we agree on the scope.
- Lead registration: we require a registration form + 90-day protection window from registration date; registration must include contact info and qualifying notes.

I’m looping in Marissa (partnerships) and Ben (sales) to iron out the operational details and draft a term sheet. Would next Wednesday 10am PT work for a quick sync? If yes, we’ll circulate a proposed agenda and a short term-sheet draft.

Cheers,

Folks — draft legal guidance below and attached term-sheet draft (redwood_co-sell_term-sheet_v1.docx).

Key suggestions (high level):

- Lead registration: require a web form + written acceptance from Redwood sales within 5 business days. Protection window: 90 days from date of acceptance (not submission).
- Commission structure (proposed):
  * Referral (intro only): 10% of first-year ARR
  * Co-sell (Skylark rep actively participates in sales cycle): 18% of first-year ARR
  * Reseller margin (Skylark invoices customer): discount to list price; negotiate on a per-deal basis
- Overlap resolution: priority to validated registrations; if both sides claim lead, require evidence (timestamped form, qualifying notes) and default to who registered first. If timestamps are within same business day and both claim credit, escalate to joint-sales manager to arbitrate.
- Exclusivity: discouraged. Exclusivity only with minimum committed ARR over 12 months (suggest $250k) and locked-in lead registration terms.
- Audit & payment: quarterly settlement reports; payments within 30 days of invoice after deal close; right to audit high-volume partners.

Attached: redwood_co-sell_term-sheet_v1.docx (term sheet with suggested clauses). Happy to iterate.

Jonas

Hi Ella — great conversation today, and thanks for the candid GTM goals. Per follow-up from our internal team, here is our proposed framework to get a pilot live and protect Skylark’s introduced opportunities:

1) Commission & economics
- Referral (intro only): 10% of first-year ARR
- Co-sell (Skylark sales participates): 18% of first-year ARR
- Reseller: negotiate a margin-led discount; we’ll provide a reseller price list once scope is agreed

2) Lead registration & overlap policy
- Registration via our partner portal form (link below); Redwood Sales must accept/acknowledge within 5 business days to trigger a 90-day protection window from acceptance date.
- Required fields: customer contact, estimated ARR, qualifying notes, source tag.
- Overlap: first validated registration wins. If both parties submit within the same business day with competing claims, we escalate to the joint-sales manager to arbitrate.

3) Exclusivity
- Not part of standard partnership. Exclusivity considered only with a minimum committed ARR of $250k over 12 months and explicit contract language.

4) Next steps
- I’ve attached the draft term sheet Jonas prepared and our proposed mutual action plan.
- Please review and confirm if these economics and the 90-day protection window are acceptable. If so, we’ll send a DocuSign link for the MOU/term sheet and enable your partner portal access.

Proposed quick win: pilot with AcmeHealth (you mentioned interest) — if Skylark can register the lead by Friday and we accept, we’ll prioritize engineering onboarding.
